evidence_items.locator: Abstract; study design in Sections III and IV
evidence_items.explanation: A randomized study of 96 Google engineers estimated about 21% less task time with completion, paste, and code-generation assistance. The task required passing tests, although the estimate had substantial uncertainty.

Sixteen experienced maintainers completed 246 randomized tasks more slowly when AI was allowed. The study covered February–June tools, primarily Cursor with Claude 3.5/3.7; it is adverse evidence for broad coding assistance, not an isolated test of autocomplete.

unresolved_gaps: Neither experiment estimates an industry-wide average effect.
The studies do not isolate the effect of autocomplete from every other assistance feature.
